Verified on `origin/main` @ `1b6188d`: the global-`fetch` probe is live at `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx:589` with `credentials: 'include'` only — bearer-token hosts get an unauthenticated read and silently lose semantic option colors and dimension labels.
